title.narrative: Strengthening Management of Social Transformations and Foresight in Uzbekistan

description.narrative:
In line with the comprehensive strategy for the MOST Programme 2022-2029, priority areas for 2025 are the following: 1) Facilitate the exchange of knowledge and experiences deploying the power of sport. 2) Strengthen local research institutions and their engagement with policymakers. 3) Promote research on gender studies that addresses contemporary social challenges. 4) Digital transformation, AI ethics.
The MOST Knowledge Brokerage Pillars will serve as key mechanisms to facilitate the execution of this work plan, leveraging specialized tools and strategies to bridge the gap between research and policymaking, fostering positive social change in Uzbekistan. This will reinforce the OP2 as a matrix workplan.
